namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Library

    /// <summary>
    /// Class LibraryManager.
    /// </summary>
    public class LibraryManager : ILibraryManager
    {
        private const string ShortcutFileExtension = ".mblink";

        private readonly ILogger<LibraryManager> _logger;
        private readonly ITaskManager _taskManager;
        private readonly IUserManager _userManager;
        private readonly IUserDataManager _userDataManager;
        private readonly IServerConfigurationManager _configurationManager;
        private readonly Lazy<ILibraryMonitor> _libraryMonitorFactory;
        private readonly Lazy<IProviderManager> _providerManagerFactory;
        private readonly Lazy<IUserViewManager> _userViewManagerFactory;
        private readonly IServerApplicationHost _appHost;
        private readonly IMediaEncoder _mediaEncoder;
        private readonly IFileSystem _fileSystem;
        private readonly IItemRepository _itemRepository;
        private readonly IItemPersistenceService _persistenceService;
        private readonly INextUpService _nextUpService;
        private readonly IItemCountService _countService;
        private readonly ILinkedChildrenService _linkedChildrenService;
        private readonly IImageProcessor _imageProcessor;
        private readonly NamingOptions _namingOptions;
        private readonly IPeopleRepository _peopleRepository;
        private readonly ExtraResolver _extraResolver;
        private readonly IPathManager _pathManager;
        private readonly FastConcurrentLru<Guid, BaseItem> _cache;
        private readonly DotIgnoreIgnoreRule _dotIgnoreIgnoreRule;

        /// <summary>
        /// The _root folder sync lock.
        /// </summary>
        private readonly Lock _rootFolderSyncLock = new();
        private readonly Lock _userRootFolderSyncLock = new();

        private readonly TimeSpan _viewRefreshInterval = TimeSpan.FromHours(24);

        /// <summary>
        /// The _root folder.
        /// </summary>
        private volatile AggregateFolder? _rootFolder;
        private volatile UserRootFolder? _userRootFolder;

        private bool _wizardCompleted;

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="LibraryManager" /> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="appHost">The application host.</param>
        /// <param name="loggerFactory">The logger factory.</param>
        /// <param name="taskManager">The task manager.</param>
        /// <param name="userManager">The user manager.</param>
        /// <param name="configurationManager">The configuration manager.</param>
        /// <param name="userDataManager">The user data manager.</param>
        /// <param name="libraryMonitorFactory">The library monitor.</param>
        /// <param name="fileSystem">The file system.</param>
        /// <param name="providerManagerFactory">The provider manager.</param>
        /// <param name="userViewManagerFactory">The user view manager.</param>
        /// <param name="mediaEncoder">The media encoder.</param>
        /// <param name="itemRepository">The item repository.</param>
        /// <param name="persistenceService">The item persistence service.</param>
        /// <param name="nextUpService">The next up service.</param>
        /// <param name="countService">The item count service.</param>
        /// <param name="linkedChildrenService">The linked children service.</param>
        /// <param name="imageProcessor">The image processor.</param>
        /// <param name="namingOptions">The naming options.</param>
        /// <param name="directoryService">The directory service.</param>
        /// <param name="peopleRepository">The people repository.</param>
        /// <param name="pathManager">The path manager.</param>
        /// <param name="dotIgnoreIgnoreRule">The .ignore rule handler.</param>
        public LibraryManager(
            IServerApplicationHost appHost,
            ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
            ITaskManager taskManager,
            IUserManager userManager,
            IServerConfigurationManager configurationManager,
            IUserDataManager userDataManager,
            Lazy<ILibraryMonitor> libraryMonitorFactory,
            IFileSystem fileSystem,
            Lazy<IProviderManager> providerManagerFactory,
            Lazy<IUserViewManager> userViewManagerFactory,
            IMediaEncoder mediaEncoder,
            IItemRepository itemRepository,
            IItemPersistenceService persistenceService,
            INextUpService nextUpService,
            IItemCountService countService,
            ILinkedChildrenService linkedChildrenService,
            IImageProcessor imageProcessor,
            NamingOptions namingOptions,
            IDirectoryService directoryService,
            IPeopleRepository peopleRepository,
            IPathManager pathManager,
            DotIgnoreIgnoreRule dotIgnoreIgnoreRule)
        {
            _appHost = appHost;
            _logger = loggerFactory.CreateLogger<LibraryManager>();
            _taskManager = taskManager;
            _userManager = userManager;
            _configurationManager = configurationManager;
            _userDataManager = userDataManager;
            _libraryMonitorFactory = libraryMonitorFactory;
            _fileSystem = fileSystem;
            _providerManagerFactory = providerManagerFactory;
            _userViewManagerFactory = userViewManagerFactory;
            _mediaEncoder = mediaEncoder;
            _itemRepository = itemRepository;
            _persistenceService = persistenceService;
            _nextUpService = nextUpService;
            _countService = countService;
            _linkedChildrenService = linkedChildrenService;
            _imageProcessor = imageProcessor;

            _cache = new FastConcurrentLru<Guid, BaseItem>(_configurationManager.Configuration.CacheSize);

            _namingOptions = namingOptions;
            _peopleRepository = peopleRepository;
            _extraResolver = new ExtraResolver(_providerManagerFactory.Value, _fileSystem, _namingOptions);
            _pathManager = pathManager;
            _dotIgnoreIgnoreRule = dotIgnoreIgnoreRule;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the root folder.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns>Task{AggregateFolder}.</returns>
        public async Task<AggregateFolder> GetRootFolderAsync()
        {
            if (_rootFolder != null)
            {
                return _rootFolder;
            }

            await _rootFolderSyncLock.LockAsync(async () =>
            {
                if (_rootFolder != null)
                {
                    return;
                }

                _rootFolder = await GetRootFolderInternalAsync();
            });

            return _rootFolder;
        }

        private async Task<AggregateFolder> GetRootFolderInternalAsync()
        {
            var rootFolder = await _itemRepository.GetRootFolderAsync();

            if (rootFolder == null)
            {
                rootFolder = new AggregateFolder
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    Name = "Root",
                    Path = string.Empty,
                    LocationType = LocationType.Virtual
                };

                await _itemRepository.AddAsync(rootFolder);
            }

            return rootFolder;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the user root folder.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="userId">The user id.</param>
        /// <returns>Task{UserRootFolder}.</returns>
        public async Task<UserRootFolder> GetUserRootFolderAsync(Guid userId)
        {
            if (_userRootFolder != null && _userRootFolder.UserId == userId)
            {
                return _userRootFolder;
            }

            await _userRootFolderSyncLock.LockAsync(async () =>
            {
                if (_userRootFolder != null && _userRootFolder.UserId == userId)
                {
                    return;
                }

                _userRootFolder = await GetUserRootFolderInternalAsync(userId);
            });

            return _userRootFolder;
        }

        private async Task<UserRootFolder> GetUserRootFolderInternalAsync(Guid userId)
        {
            var userRootFolder = await _itemRepository.GetUserRootFolderAsync(userId);

            if (userRootFolder == null)
            {
                userRootFolder = new UserRootFolder
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    UserId = userId,
                    Name = "User Root",
                    Path = string.Empty,
                    LocationType = LocationType.Virtual
                };

                await _itemRepository.AddAsync(userRootFolder);
            }

            return userRootFolder;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Refreshes the view.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="userId">The user id.</param>
        /// <param name="view">The view.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
        /// <returns>Task.</returns>
        public async Task RefreshViewAsync(Guid userId, View view, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            await _userViewManagerFactory.Value.RefreshViewAsync(userId, view, cancellationToken);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the items.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="userId">The user id.</param>
        /// <param name="parentId">The parent id.</param>
        /// <param name="includeHidden">if set to <c>true</c> [include hidden].</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
        /// <returns>Task{IEnumerable{BaseItem}}.</returns>
        public async Task<IEnumerable<BaseItem>> GetItemsAsync(Guid userId, Guid parentId, bool includeHidden, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            return await _itemRepository.GetItemsAsync(userId, parentId, includeHidden, cancellationToken);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the item.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="id">The id.</param>
        /// <param name="userId">The user id.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
        /// <returns>Task{BaseItem}.</returns>
        public async Task<BaseItem> GetItemAsync(Guid id, Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            return await _itemRepository.GetItemAsync(id, userId, cancellationToken);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Adds the item.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="item">The item.</param>
        /// <param name="userId">The user id.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
        /// <returns>Task.</returns>
        public async Task AddItemAsync(BaseItem item, Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            await _itemRepository.AddAsync(item, userId, cancellationToken);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Updates the item.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="item">The item.</param>
        /// <param name="userId">The user id.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
        /// <returns>Task.</returns>
        public async Task UpdateItemAsync(BaseItem item, Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            await _itemRepository.UpdateAsync(item, userId, cancellationToken);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Deletes the item.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="id">The id.</param>
        /// <param name="userId">The user id.</param>
        /// <param name="options">The options.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
        /// <returns>Task.</returns>
        public async Task DeleteItemAsync(Guid id, Guid userId, DeleteOptions options, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var item = await GetItemAsync(id, userId, cancellationToken);

            if (item == null)
            {
                throw new ItemNotFoundException(id);
            }

            await DeleteItemInternalAsync(item, options, cancellationToken);
        }

        private async Task DeleteItemInternalAsync(BaseItem item, DeleteOptions options, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (item.IsFolder)
            {
                var folder = (Folder)item;

                foreach (var child in folder.Children)
                {
                    await DeleteItemInternalAsync(child, options, cancellationToken);
                }
            }

            await _itemRepository.DeleteAsync(item, cancellationToken);

            if (options.DeleteFileLocation && item.IsFileProtocol)
            {
                await DeleteFileLocationAsync(item, cancellationToken);
            }
        }

        private async Task DeleteFileLocationAsync(BaseItem item, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var fileSystemInfo = item.GetDeletePaths().FirstOrDefault();

            if (fileSystemInfo != null)
            {
                await _fileSystem.DeleteFileAsync(fileSystemInfo.FullName, cancellationToken);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Moves the item.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="id">The id.</param>
        /// <param name="newParentId">The new parent id.</param>
        /// <param name="userId">The user id.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
        /// <returns>Task.</returns>
        public async Task MoveItemAsync(Guid id, Guid newParentId, Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var item = await GetItemAsync(id, userId, cancellationToken);

            if (item == null)
            {
                throw new ItemNotFoundException(id);
            }

            var newParent = await GetItemAsync(newParentId, userId, cancellationToken);

            if (newParent == null)
            {
                throw new ItemNotFoundException(newParentId);
            }

            await _itemRepository.MoveAsync(item, newParent, userId, cancellationToken);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Copies the item.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="id">The id.</param>
        /// <param name="newParentId">The new parent id.</param>
        /// <param name="userId">The user id.</param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken">The cancellation token.</param>
        /// <returns>Task{BaseItem}.</returns>
        public async Task<BaseItem> CopyItemAsync(Guid id, Guid newParentId, Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var item = await GetItemAsync(id, userId, cancellationToken);

            if (item == null)
            {
                throw new ItemNotFoundException(id);
            }

            var newParent = await GetItemAsync(newParentId, userId, cancellationToken);

            if (newParent == null)
            {
                throw new ItemNotFoundException(newParentId);
            }

            var newItem = await _itemRepository.CopyAsync(item, newParent, userId, cancellationToken);

            return newItem;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the metadata paths.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="item">The item.</param>
        /// <param name="children">The children.</param>
        /// <returns>IEnumerable{string}.</returns>
        private IEnumerable<string> GetMetadataPaths(BaseItem item, IEnumerable<BaseItem> children)
        {
            var metadataPaths = new List<string>();

            if (item.IsFolder)
            {
                var folder = (Folder)item;

                metadataPaths.AddRange(folder.GetMetadataPaths());

                foreach (var child in children)
                {
                    metadataPaths.AddRange(GetMetadataPaths(child, child.GetRecursiveChildren(false)));
                }
            }

            return metadataPaths;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Deletes the metadata path.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="item">The item.</param>
        /// <param name="metadataPath">The metadata path.</param>
        private void DeleteMetadataPath(BaseItem item, string metadataPath)
        {
            try
            {
                Directory.Delete(metadataPath, true);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error deleting {MetadataPath}", metadataPath);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Reroutes the linked child references.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="itemId">The item id.</param>
        /// <param name="primaryVersionId">The primary version id.</param>
        /// <returns>Task.</returns>
        private async Task RerouteLinkedChildReferencesAsync(Guid itemId, Guid primaryVersionId)
        {
            var item = await GetItemAsync(itemId, Guid.Empty, CancellationToken.None);

            if (item == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            var primaryVersion = await GetItemAsync(primaryVersionId, Guid.Empty, CancellationToken.None);

            if (primaryVersion == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            var children = item.GetRecursiveChildren(false);

            foreach (var child in children)
            {
                if (child.LinkedAlternateVersions != null)
                {
                    child.LinkedAlternateVersions = child.LinkedAlternateVersions
                        .Where(lc => !lc.ItemId.HasValue || !lc.ItemId.Value.Equals(itemId))
                        .ToArray();
                }
            }

            await UpdateItemAsync(item, Guid.Empty, CancellationToken.None);
        }
    }
}
